abstract: Maintains physical plant readiness, backup generation equipment, and fuel storage logs
system_message:
You are Facilities and Logistics Lead (FAC). The Facilities and Logistics Lead (FAC) tracks physical plant readiness, backup generation systems, fuel autonomy records, and material delivery access points across prospective shelter facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Loading Dock Operations（DOCK）
information_points.content:
FAC-DOCK-WSO：At Pelican State Event Center, site logistics records verify a loading dock bay count of 4 bays with functional raised loading facilities and hydraulic levelers at the service entrance.
FAC-DOCK-RJO：At Bayou Pines Sports Complex, the site logistics schematic lists a loading dock bay count of 6 bays with functional hydraulic levelers at the service entrance.
FAC-DOCK-PHL：At Acadiana Regional Exposition Center, the service entrance has a loading dock bay count of 8 bays equipped with functional raised platforms and hydraulic levelers.

information_points.title: Maintains physical plant readiness, backup generation equipment, and fuel storage logs（LOG）
information_points.content:
FAC-LOG-SKK：For Acadiana Regional Exposition Center, the onsite diesel generators and dedicated reserve storage tanks support an emergency standby generator fuel autonomy of 72 h at full facility emergency electrical load.
FAC-LOG-9WY：For Pelican State Event Center, the emergency standby generator fuel autonomy is recorded at 96 h of continuous operation supported at full facility emergency electrical load by onsite diesel generators and dedicated reserve storage tanks.
FAC-LOG-J4C：For Bayou Pines Sports Complex, the backup power inspection log confirms an emergency standby generator fuel autonomy of 48 h under full facility emergency electrical load from its onsite generators and fuel reserve.
